title.en: Income Tax (Trafigura Pte Ltd — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Trafigura Pte Ltd — Section 13(12) Exemption) Order 2026.

2.—(1) Branch profits received in Singapore by Trafigura Pte Ltd (a company incorporated in Singapore) on or after 2 January 2026 from its branches in Montevideo, Uruguay and Dubai, United Arab Emirates are exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption in sub‑paragraph (1) is subject to the conditions specified in the letter from the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore dated 2 January 2026 that is issued on behalf of the Minister for Finance and addressed to Trafigura Pte Ltd.
